description: This file defines the RedirectResponseSubscriber class, which implements event-driven manipulation of redirect responses in Drupal, ensuring redirect safety and handling external URLs.

classes.name: RedirectResponseSubscriber
classes.description: Handles response events to manipulate redirect responses, ensuring safety and compliance with site policies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the subscriber with necessary services and context.

methods.name: checkRedirectUrl
methods.description: Main handler that modifies redirect responses based on query parameters and safety checks.

methods.name: getDestinationAsAbsoluteUrl
methods.description: Converts relative or internal URLs into absolute URLs for redirect headers.

methods.name: setIgnoreDestination
methods.description: Configures whether to ignore the 'destination' query parameter during redirects.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Registers the event listener for response events.
